entities.name: Asim
entities.role: Father of the injured boy in Istanbul
entities.description: An angry, weathered traveler who blamed Khalid and Ayesha for his son's injuries.
entities.quote: Asim stood tall — a weathered man in tattered traveling robes, veins bulging in his neck, eyes wet with rage.

entities.name: Nasab ibn Khalil
entities.role: Officer of the Ottoman elite, father of Khalid
entities.description: A feared and praised Ottoman officer, husband of Ayesha, and father of Khalid, later assassinated in his home.
entities.quote: Nasab ibn Khalil, an officer of the Ottoman elite — the lion of the court, feared and praised — was now crawling, trembling, bleeding out in his own home.

entities.name: Ayesha
entities.description: A graceful woman known for feeding orphans, married to Nasab, and mother to Khalid, later murdered by her son Kelvan.
entities.quote: Ayesha stepped out of her room, tying her shawl. Her brows furrowed at the sight on the floor — a thin red trail like a wounded serpent

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: A man said to have defied death, killed 160, burned alive, and walked again, seeking the pendant to release an ancient entity.
entities.quote: Zaan: “Mind if I sit?” Khalid: “No one stopped you.” Zaan: “You’re not scared of me?” Khalid: “I’ve seen worse than burned skin.”

entities.name: Ramij
entities.description: An operative who aided Khalid and Ayesha, father of Issabela, and former protector of the pendant before being killed by a spear.
entities.quote: A spear flew past him — and landed straight in Ramij’s chest. Ramij (gasping): “RUN!”

entities.name: Issabela
entities.description: Daughter of Ramiz, leader within the Nullborn, a skilled warrior who hid her true Muslim name, Zaynab, and grew close to Khalid.
entities.quote: Issabela: “You already know. Or you wouldn’t have survived this long.”

entities.name: Marco
entities.description: A Nullborn warrior whose parents were murdered by Cesare Borgia, later killed protecting Ayesha.

entities.name: Mehnaz
entities.description: A cynical yet capable Nullborn warrior who trained Khalid and was later killed during the cathedral massacre.

entities.name: Anna la Sarta
entities.description: Issabela's cold and ruthless sister who left the Nullborn, later found crucified and murdered inside the cathedral's secret seal chamber.
entities.quote: Anna la Sarta. Her aura was different — not fire... but ice.

entities.name: Abdul
entities.description: A gruff Nullborn warrior who helped train Khalid and lost both parents to political intrigue before being decapitated by Borgia forces.

entities.name: Nullborn
entities.description: An underground rebellion organization originally meant to protect the world, operating under Rome's catacombs.
entities.quote: Marco: “We’re Nullborn. A rebellion that was meant to protect the world. Until Rome twisted it.”

entities.name: Hidden Ones
entities.description: An organization that intervened to stop the summoning of Maphistoe.
entities.quote: Anna: “We stopped him. The Hidden Ones. We ended him. Not for vengeance. For survival.”

timeline_events.title: The Confrontation at the Ottoman Estate
timeline_events.description: Asim confronts Ayesha and Nasab over a mysterious physical altercation involving Khalid.
timeline_events.quote: Asim stood tall — a weathered man in tattered traveling robes, veins bulging in his neck, eyes wet with rage.

timeline_events.title: The Assassination of Nasab ibn Khalil
timeline_events.description: Masked assassins infiltrate the Ottoman estate and murder Nasab ibn Khalil while Ayesha is injured trying to save him.
timeline_events.quote: SHINK! A blade pierced straight through Nasab’s chest from behind. He gasped. Blood poured from his mouth.

timeline_events.title: The Flight to Rome
timeline_events.description: Following betrayal and political fallout in Istanbul, Ayesha and Khalid flee across the Mediterranean to Papal Rome guided by Ramij.
timeline_events.quote: The Mediterranean Sea stretched like an endless sheet of liquid silver beneath the moon. Their small boat rocked gently

timeline_events.title: The Awakening in the Nullborn Compound
timeline_events.description: After Ramij's death, Khalid is captured and brought to the secret Nullborn compound beneath Rome, where he meets Issabela and begins harsh training.
timeline_events.quote: He woke up in stone room lit by a blue-glass lantern. Chained. Sitting. A woman in military leather sat near the corner.

timeline_events.title: The Massacre at Ayesha's Home
timeline_events.description: Borgia forces attack Ayesha's home, murdering Marco and Ayesha to steal the ancient pendant fragment.
timeline_events.quote: There, on the blood-soaked floor... lay Marco. His right arm gone, sliced brutally. His throat pierced clean through.
